title: Zebra Rope Canonical Representation
description: A width x height grid with solid lines and a solid outer border. Ropes are gray polylines through cell centres, stored as ordered lists of [row, col] cells whose consecutive cells are 8-neighbours (a diagonal step passes only the two cells it joins). Circle clues sit on interior grid lines (edge midpoints or corners, never cell centres) in doubled coordinates where cell (r, c) centre is (2r+1, 2c+1). The solver shades cells: each circle tells which kind is the majority of the cells touching it, and each rope's cells are all unshaded, all shaded, or alternate along the rope.

ropes.description: Ropes. Each is an ordered list of [row, col] cells, at least 2; consecutive cells are 8-neighbours and no cell repeats within a rope.

dc.description: Doubled column coordinate. Interior: 1 <= dc <= 2*width - 1. At least one of dr, dc is even.

color.description: 0 = white (more unshaded cells), 1 = black (more shaded cells), 2 = gray (equal).
